name: print-social-red-radial-grid-lesson-with-fan-cropped-photos
title: Radial Grid Lesson Post
whatItIs: A red post over a light grid with yellow heading '02 Radial Grid', a definition, a sample where two photos are cut into wedges fanning from a central point with guide lines, a yellow angled headline and Save and Follow buttons.
whatItMeans: The sample demonstrates the technique and the red and yellow are loud enough to stop a scroll.
techniques: Photos cropped into wedges that radiate from one point
Thin guide lines extending from the centre
Angled yellow headline echoing the radial idea
Series header with account and follow buttons

vocabulary.definition: A layout arranged in a circular pattern around a centre.
An image cut into a triangular slice.
The centre from which elements radiate.
